title: Women Special Kashmir Group Departure
shortDescription: Discover a paradise of snow-capped mountains, serene valleys, shimmering lakes and breathtaking landscapes with an unforgettable ladies-only escape to Kashmir.
description: Discover a paradise of snow-capped mountains, serene valleys, shimmering lakes and breathtaking landscapes with an unforgettable ladies-only escape to Kashmir. Let the beauty of the Valley slow you down as you experience its picturesque surroundings, charming local culture and timeless appeal. From scenic mountain vistas and tranquil waters to memorable sightseeing and delightful local experiences, Kashmir offers the perfect setting for a refreshing break from the everyday.

This special group departure is created for women who want to explore, connect and make beautiful memories together in one of India’s most captivating destinations. Travel comfortably with a like-minded group, embrace the beauty around you and return with stories you'll love sharing. Some journeys give you photographs; the best ones give you memories for a lifetime. Kashmir is ready to give you both.

itinerary.title: Arrival Srinagar
itinerary.description: Arrive at Srinagar Airport and transfer to the hotel. Check in and settle into your stay. Enjoy a one-hour shikara ride on Dal Lake at Nehru Park. Visit a local handicrafts showroom showcasing carpets, shawls, and jewellery.

itinerary.title: Sonmarg Day Excursion
itinerary.description: Travel to Sonmarg on a full-day excursion from Srinagar. Explore the Sonmarg valley known as the Meadow of Gold. View Thajiwas Glacier with optional pony hire. Drive back to Srinagar by evening.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg Mountain Escape
itinerary.description: Drive from Srinagar to Gulmarg after breakfast. Take in views of the surrounding mountains and landscapes. Opt for a short trek to Khilanmarg or a Gondola ride to Kongdoori (on direct payment basis). Spend time exploring Gulmarg at your own pace.

itinerary.title: Scenic Drive to Pahalgam
itinerary.description: Depart Gulmarg for Pahalgam after breakfast. Drive via Pampore, Avantipura, and Bijbehara village. Pass through Anantnag while following the Lidder River route. Check in at the hotel and enjoy leisure time.

itinerary.title: Mughal Gardens and Houseboat
itinerary.description: Drive from Pahalgam to Srinagar after breakfast. Visit Chashme Shahi, Shalimar Garden, and Nishat Garden. Stop at Shankaracharya Temple. Transfer to a houseboat in the evening.

itinerary.title: Departure from Srinagar
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and morning time at leisure. Transfer to Srinagar Airport for onward journey.

inclusions: Daily Breakfast and Dinner at the respective hotels
Comfortable vehicle for all transfers and sightseeing as per the itinerary
